game.title: BioShock Remastered
game.blurb: Remaster of the 2007 first-person shooter BioShock, set in the underwater city of Rapture; RAWG lists Feral Interactive, Digital Extremes, 2K Australia, 2K Marin, Virtuos, 2K China, Blind Squirrel and 2K Boston, and 2K Games as publisher. Released 2016-09-15. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genre: Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story of Rapture
chapters.summary: From Welcome to Rapture through the hidden story milestones, the bosses and the endings. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Little Sisters
chapters.summary: Dealing with every Little Sister and finishing without harvesting any.

chapters.title: Research Camera
chapters.summary: Research photos of Splicers, the Bouncer, Rosie and Little Sisters, up to maxing all research.

chapters.title: Hacking
chapters.summary: Hacking security bots, turrets, cameras, vending machines and safes.

chapters.title: Weapon Upgrades and Inventing
chapters.summary: Upgrading weapons, inventing items and every ammo type.

chapters.title: Plasmids and Tonics
chapters.summary: Buying Plasmid and Tonic slots, maxing the tracks and collecting Tonics.

chapters.title: Challenge Rooms
chapters.summary: The three Little Sister rescue rooms named in the achievements: "The 'I' in Team", "A Shocking Turn of Events" and "Worlds of Hurt", with time, collectable Rose and style goals.

chapters.title: Audio Diaries and Other Feats
chapters.summary: Every audio diary, the slot machine jackpot, shocking enemies in water and the hardest difficulty.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/BioShock
Fandom (bioshock.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://bioshock.fandom.com/wiki/BioShock:_The_Collection
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 409710 is the remaster itself ("BioShock™ Remastered" in the store list); the original 2007 app (7670, "BioShock™") was not used. Its Steam schema is named "BeachTree" (an internal codename). RAWG's first result is the right game (slug bioshock-remastered); RAWG keeps BioShock 2 Remastered and BioShock: The Collection separately. 13 of 65 Steam achievements are hidden; most are named for story bosses or milestones and sit in the story chapter. The 12 Challenge Rooms achievements are all below 5%. The chapter name "Challenge Rooms" is a page name on bioshock.fandom.com; the three room names come from the achievement text and also appear on StrategyWiki's contents list. StrategyWiki redirects "BioShock Remastered" to "BioShock" (completion stage 2), but its walkthrough is mostly unwritten: only Welcome to Rapture and Medical Pavilion of its 13 level pages are written, plus Controls, Enemies, Plasmids and Tonics, Power to the People and Achievements and trophies, so it was not used. bioshock.fandom.com redirects "BioShock Remastered" to "BioShock: The Collection", with about 142 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
